Leaflet 1.9.4 is vendored locally from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css and https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js. The original BSD 2-Clause license is in LEAFLET-LICENSE.txt. No runtime CDN is needed for the map library. Circle markers do not require external marker icons.

SHA256 CSS: A7837102824184820DFA198D1EBCD109FF6D0FF9A2672A074B9A1B4D147D04C6
SHA256 JS: DB49D009C841F5CA34A888C96511AE936FD9F5533E90D8B2C4D57596F4E5641A

Tiles are OpenStreetMap Standard with on-map and surrounding attribution. No fetched JSON or SPA rendering is used. Without JavaScript or map tiles the complete SSR result list and detail links remain available. Optional Google Fonts fall back to the user's system sans-serif fonts.
